# AI v2 design todo, part C (code TODO, not for the designer)

The designer can skip this file: it is the developer's list.

## C. In design, missing in code: code TODO (v2 philosophy)

Recommendation: **add** = build it; **adapt** = build a smaller v2 version; **drop** = do not build, the canvas element moves to section A as "remove from design".

| ID | Design element | What code does now | Recommendation | Pri |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C-01 | **Markdown in step titles** (the lead writes `**bold**` and `` `code` `` in its steps) | Report and question text are rendered (`MarkdownRenderer plain`). Step titles are stripped to plain text only in `activity/RunPanel.tsx` (`plainTitle`). Still raw (`**` visible) in `ai/run/RunTree.tsx`, `AiThread.tsx` `RunWorkingRow`, `aiteam/NowTab.tsx` live steps, Timeline popovers. | **Add**: one shared inline-markdown renderer (bold, code, links, no blocks) for every place a step title is shown; keep the 300-char truncation. This is a real bug. | P1 |
| C-02 | **Question card: "Answer later"** | Not in code. A question simply waits; the run stays "needs input". | **Drop**: not answering already is "later"; no lock to release. Remove the button from the canvas (A). | P3 |
| C-03 | **Question card: "Ask someone else"** | Not in the card. Server has the pieces unused: `on_run_question(passed_to=…)` in `server/services/notifications.py` and `question.to`; no route calls it. | **Adapt**: a small "Ask <person> instead" picker that sets `question.to` and notifies them; low priority, only useful with several humans. | P3 |
| C-04 | **Question card: suggested choices** | Done: `options`, `optionDetails` (one line each), one marked recommended, "Something else", free text only when no options. | Nothing to build. Design must show it (B-06). | – |
| C-05 | **Reminders of an open question** (15 min, then every 2 h) | Only the first notification is sent (`runs.py` → `on_run_question(run_id)`); the `reminder` parameter is never used. | **Adapt**: send the reminder (as a notification only, never a board action), no timer on the run. | P2 |
| C-06 | **24 h timeout of an open question** | None; a waiting run stays "needs input". | **Drop**: the board must not fail the AI's work because a person is away. (Design: remove.) | P2 |
| C-07 | **Open in terminal** (copy `claude --resume <id>`) | Only in the static mock `activity/design/designBlocks.tsx`. The run has `sessionId`, and the account's config dir is known. | **Add**: a button "Open in terminal" on the run panel that copies `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=… claude --resume <session id>` (the person takes over the same session by hand). Replaces "Take over". | P1 |
| C-08 | **Failed / timed-out card** (reason, last step, what changed) | State `timed_out` is in the UI chips (`RunHistoryTable`, `RunPanel`, `CardAiFooter`) but **the server never produces it** (no wall-clock limit in v2). Failed run: red notice with `endedReason`, "Retry" button, board card shows chip + Retry. No "last step", no "what changed". | **Adapt**: for failed/stopped runs show `endedReason` + last step title + files changed (from `run.files`) in one card. **Drop** the `timed_out` state from code and canvas unless a run timeout is added. | P1 |
| C-09 | **Run history status-change wording** | Present: "no changes (answer only)", "N files", "branch · N files", column-move chips, "no status change". Missing: "partial changes kept" for a stopped or failed run that left files. | **Adapt**: add "stopped — N files kept in the worktree" for cancelled/failed with files. | P2 |
| C-10 | **Undo run's changes** | `RevertChange.tsx` deleted. Worktree "remove" and "keep" exist in `ai/code/TicketHandover.tsx`. | **Drop** a board-side undo (git is the tool; the philosophy says no board-run safety net). Point the design at "Discard worktree". | P2 |
| C-11 | **Take over** (human takes the run) | Not in code. | **Drop**, replaced by C-07 (resume the session in a terminal). | P2 |
| C-12 | **Limits, daily cap and monthly budget** (design AiSafetyCost) | Code has them (`AiSettingsSection.tsx` `LimitSettings`): "Teams pause once the project has spent this much", Runs a day, At once, Memory of one run. Users are on subscriptions (quota, not money). | **Adapt**: keep At once, Memory of one run and the kill switch; hide the money caps unless a run reports a real cost; decide with the user. | P2 |
| C-13 | **Review gate** (summary with claims, Approve → Done, Request changes) | Not enforced, intended. The lead's report is shown (B-05). | **Drop** (section A). A person moves the ticket by hand. | P1 |
| C-14 | **"Not metered"** | Shown whenever `costUsd` is 0 (`activity/RunPanel.tsx`, `RunHistoryTable.tsx`, `RunView.tsx` Usage card, `TimelineTab.tsx`). The CLI result does carry `total_cost_usd` and tokens, so ended runs show money and tokens. | **Adapt**: show cost and tokens; show "Not metered" only while a run has not reported yet. | P2 |
| C-15 | **Stale settings search entries** | `components/settings/settingsIndex.ts` still lists Safe mode, "Max chain depth", "Approvals expire after", Board daily cap, Docs "proposal" keywords. They search for settings that no longer exist. | **Fix** in code: remove or rename the entries. | P2 |
| C-16 | **Stale v1 wording in the Timeline and thread** | `aiteam/TimelineTab.tsx` still has "Hand-offs", "The checks failed the work and sent it back", "Review changes", "Not metered"; `RunHistoryTable` header says "Agent". Another session owns the Timeline; report to it. | **Fix** after the Timeline session ends; wording from the new design. | P2 |
| C-17 | **Per-run Pause / Resume** | `RunActions` gone, `run.paused` is always false; `RunStateChip 'paused'` branch in `RunView.tsx` is dead. Team-level Pause/Resume and the project "Pause all AI" remain. | **Drop** the dead per-run code; keep team and project pause (design AiPaused changes, see A). | P3 |
| C-18 | **Activity mock switch** | `MOCK_AI_ACTIVITY = true` in `activity/mock.ts` still sends the ticket to `AiActivityDesign`. That path has the question card, report, note box and (since B-37) the folded group per subagent and the messages list (B-02, `RunMessages`), but not what only the other path has: the two-level role tree (`RunTree`, B-08; B-37 is its flat form), the paused / signed-out strips of `TicketAiPanel` (B-19) and **`TicketHandover`, the worktree / pull request hand-over (B-24), which the AI tab does not show at all while the switch is on** (checked in `TicketModal.tsx` 2026-11-07). | **Decide**: make the design path the only one and port the strips and the hand-over into it (or drop them; B-08 is then B-37). Code task, not a design task. | P1 |
| C-19 | **v1 wording and leftovers still in code** (found while checking the canvases) | Drag-confirm text "releases the hold" (`ai/DragConfirm.tsx`); Repositories text "run by the Checks step of a workflow" (`ai/code/RepositoriesSection.tsx`); schedules empty state "and have another AI check it" (`schedules/*`); `ThreadChip` "Move blocked" state; `proposedByLine` still knows "light model" and "diagnosis" (`ai/knowledge/*`); card footer "AI summary ready" when a finished run sits in Review (`CardAiFooter`); `TestCaseMention` still offers Ask / Just notify; `AiCompletedBadge`; Members page hint "…and @mentioned in {project}"; `RunHistoryTable` header "Agent". | **Fix** in code: reword to the v2 meaning ("Report ready", "Send to {team}"), delete dead branches. Design for the banner is missing (A-190). | P1 |
